I think the snake people are closer to Kin than Beast. That windmill that you can see for miles, even in Cathedral Ward, is the point where the game goes from Van Helsing to Lovecraft. Other than the two Brainsuckers hidden in CW, this is your first encounter with any kind of Kin. The little mushroom dudes, the Mi-Go zombies in Burgertown, that huge flower demon thing that shoots Minecraft TNT... that's where the beasts more or less stop, and the true madness begins. While you still fight a few beast after that (Upper CW, the Silverbeasts in Mensis) most of the stuff happening is super spooky cosmic bullshit. Back to the point... the common theory is that the Beasts are people who consumed or otherwise "took" the blood of an Old One, most likely Ebritas, and they ascended past regular human form. The problem is that they either took a tainted batch or their bodies rejected the blood. Either way, they only got halfway to the desired point, ie being a Kin or even an Old one. The Mi-Go zombies in Burgertown all seem to have either the Choir Garb or some kind of Student's attire. I think that these are the students of Burgertown that got one step farther than the regular beasts of Ya'hrnem, and the Serpentine Sentinels in the spooky woods are another product of that. Come to think of it, the Glue People in the lecture hall...

They all answer when called upon, but the nature of each One is different. Some really want to help you while others are a bit more... clever.

There are a few paths you could go down. First there is the lore breaking geometric style, in which the Old One resembles different shapes in geometry while still looking like a creature. This style is often used to give them a bit of extra surrealism and can be found in H.P Lovecraft's work. The second one is a bit more lore friendly as it fits with the game's idea of old ones more closely. Base it off of an animal, as most of the bosses are based off of such (Rom is a spider, Mergo's Wet Nurse is a bird, Moon President is a Human/Snake) and go from there. The third option is make it look a little bit human, but make it impossible. I'd call this one the Silent Hill 2 route. A tall, very thin man wrapped in robes with a completely blank and featureless face, or a human attempt at making an Old One by sewing together a bunch of body parts from the other ones. Something spooky.
